```{r}
clasp_surp_with_context <- read.csv("../annotated/surprisal/clasp/clasp_with_context_by_worker_and_sent/pythia-1.4b-deduped-step1000-full.tsv", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(
    answer = as.numeric(answer),
    lang_id = as.factor(lang_id),
    prefix_length = str_count(prefix, " ") + 1,
    sent_length = str_count(sent, " ") + 1,
    suffix_length = str_count(suffix, " ") + 1,
    input_length = prefix_length + sent_length,
    mean_surprisal = sentence_surprisal/sent_length
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(answer))

#   mutate(lang_id = as.factor(lang_id))
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
clasp_surp_with_context %>%
  subset(select = -c(lang_id)) %>%
  group_by(sent_id) %>%
  summarise(
    across(answer:mean_surprisal, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = input_length, y = mean_surprisal, fill = answer)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
clasp_surp_with_context0 <- clasp_surp_with_context %>%
  subset(select = -c(lang_id)) %>%
  group_by(sent_id, WorkerId) %>%
  summarise(
    across(answer:mean_surprisal, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sentence_surprisal_s = scale(sentence_surprisal),
    prefix_length_s = scale(prefix_length),
    suffix_length_s = scale(suffix_length),
    sent_length_s = scale(sent_length),
    mean_surprisal_s = scale(mean_surprisal),
    input_length_s = scale(input_length),
    # for beta family we need values striclty < 1 and > 0
    answer_s = scales::rescale(answer, to = c(0.001, 0.999))
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(clasp_surp_with_context0) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = answer), bins = 20) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
descdist(clasp_surp_with_context0$answer_s, discrete=FALSE, boot=500)
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(clasp_surp_with_context0$mean_surprisal_s))
sum(is.na(clasp_surp_with_context0$sent_length_s))
sum(is.na(clasp_surp_with_context0$prefix_length_s))
```

```{r}
clasp_ivs <- read.csv("../iv_results/clasp/iv_temp_125.csv") %>%
  group_by(document_id) %>%
  summarize(
    across(d1_recurrence_uniform_n_valid:d_semantic_euclidean_min, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    document_id = as.integer(str_sub(document_id, 7, 10))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sent_id = document_id
  )
fit_df <- merge(x = clasp_surp_with_context0, y = clasp_ivs,  by = c("sent_id"), all.x = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      sentence_surprisal:d_semantic_euclidean_min, ~as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_s"
    )
  )
# sample an exploratory set of half of the participants
sampled_WorkerIds <- fit_df %>%
  pull(WorkerId) %>%
  sample(size = 75)
expl_df <- fit_df %>%
  filter(WorkerId %in% sampled_WorkerIds)

```

Model selection

```{r}
# intercept-only model (how much is the rating affected by the identity of the participant?)
m0 <- glmmTMB(answer_s ~ 1 + (1|WorkerId), data = expl_df, family = gaussian())
r2(m0)
```

```{r}
# context model - does the amount of context (number of words) matter for the rating?
m_context <- glmmTMB(answer_s ~ prefix_length_s + (1|WorkerId), data = expl_df, gaussian())
anova(m_context, m0)
```
No improvement over intercept-only model -> discard

```{r}
# missing context model - how important is the amount of text the participant hasn't seen yet?
m_missing_context <- glmmTMB(answer_s ~ suffix_length_s + (1|WorkerId), data = expl_df, gaussian())
anova(m0, m_missing_context)
summary(m_missing_context)
```

This effect is vanishingly small -> discard!

```{r}
# sentence-length model
m_sent_length <- glmmTMB(answer_s ~ sent_length_s + (1|WorkerId), data = expl_df, gaussian())
anova(m0, m_sent_length)
```

No effect of sentence length either!

```{r}
m_surprisal <- glmmTMB(answer_s ~ mean_surprisal_s + (1|WorkerId), data = expl_df, gaussian())
anova(m0, m_surprisal)
```

```{r}
anova(m_ivs0, m_ivs1)
```

Defining models

```{r}
m0_formula <- answer_s ~ mean_surprisal_s + (1|WorkerId)
m1_formula <- answer_s ~ mean_surprisal_s + d_syntactic_1gram_mean_s + d_semantic_cosine_mean_s + d1_recurrence_exponential_mean_s + d2_new_head_mean_s + (1|WorkerId)
```


Cross-validation

```{r}
set.seed(123)
results <- model_cross_val(m0_formula, m1_formula, fit_df, model_family=beta_family, group_var = "WorkerId", num_folds = 5)
```


```{r}
cv_summary <- results$cv_summary
fixef_summary <- results$fixef_summary
cat("\nMean delta log-likelihood per item (m1 - m0):", mean(cv_summary$delta_ll, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean RMSE m0:", mean(cv_summary$rmse0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean RMSE m1:", mean(cv_summary$rmse1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean delta RMSE (m1 - m0):", mean(cv_summary$delta_rmse, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean delta marginal R2:", mean(cv_summary$delta_r2m, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean delta conditional R2:", mean(cv_summary$delta_r2c, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```
```{r}
fixef_summary %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
